user_authorization: Production image tools authorized; no images or image links in main chat. Exactly one new required idle-role correction attempt.
corrective_reason: Existing NW idle exposes front chest instead of absolute rear view. New rear idle uses verified N and NE rear assets plus original portrait only; never old NW or failed NW walk.
prompt:
Create ONE production sprite sheet: SIX subtly articulated IDLE poses of the SAME unique boss Halpas, in a true NORTHWEST rear three-quarter direction toward screen UPPER-LEFT, away from viewer. Image1 is original identity/material authority ONLY. Image2 is the verified NORTH rear idle with correct back armor, equipment hand and wing anatomy. Image3 is verified NORTHEAST rear idle as alternate rear-perspective reference. Construct a NEW NORTHWEST rear view by turning the NORTH model45degrees toward screen upper-left, NEVER mirroring it. Do not copy any front-facing pose from original portrait. Do not invent a new design.

ABSOLUTE COMPASS/VIEW: ALL6 show the BACK of helmet, articulated gold-trimmed dark BACKPLATE/SPINE, rear shoulder armor and cape back. The front skull breastplate and face must be HIDDEN on opposite side of torso, never visible. Helmet nose direction if glimpsed is upper-left away from viewer. Torso, pelvic axis, boots, knees and guard all share same fixed NW heading. No front view, front-left/SW pose, side/front face, rightward body reversal, viewpoint change or rotation during cycle. We must recognize a dominant rear silhouette in every phase, not a front-view person merely pointing the sword up-left.

EQUIPMENT HANDEDNESS IS CRITICAL: Preserve the anatomical RIGHT sword hand from NORTH rear reference image2. In NORTH rear reference the sword arm is on VIEWER RIGHT of the spine, and burgundy cape hangs on VIEWER LEFT. After rotating the whole model toward NW, that SAME RIGHT shoulder and weapon hand remain on the viewer-right/near-right edge of the BACK, with the elbow/forearm and purple sword clearly connected on that side. Sword held down-right to side in guard, never transferred to left shoulder or mirrored onto viewer-left. Cape remains attached to same anatomical LEFT side as NORTH model, visible left/back and draping downward-left behind pelvis, never exchanged with sword arm. Helmet and armor asymmetries remain attached to anatomy. No new weapon, shield, cloth or equipment.

Retain TWO actual solid purple crystalline feather-fan WINGS attached to the two GOLD shoulder/back roots, exactly the established model. Rotate with body naturally: nearer right wing and foreshortened far left wing must BOTH remain visibly present with identifiable gold roots and purple crystal fans. Do not collapse wings to just one fan; do not change wing shape to membrane or add extra wing pairs. Preserve black-gold armor, articulated narrow back/spine plates, horned helmet, complete legs/boots, torn burgundy cape, established short broad purple crystalline sword. High-detail crisp game-sprite rendering, same elevated orthographic isometric camera as references.

This is IDLE, so no walking or footstep requirement: six distinct quiet breathing/hover-balance phases, same steady guard and NW heading. Phase0 neutral calm guard, phase1 small chest/back breathing expansion with shoulders rising and wing joints lifting, phase2 upper breath with slightly opened wings and delayed cape tip sway, phase3 controlled exhale with wing joints lowering and hands/forearms subtly relaxing, phase4 lowest breath with wings slightly folded and cape response catching up, phase5 returning toward neutral with subtly different wing fingers and cloak fold shapes. Real articulated changes to wing roots, forearms and cloth; do not duplicate/translate identical figures. Keep same anatomy/hand, scale and full silhouette. Do not bend/swap support legs into walk or perform attack.

ATLAS exact1024x1536 PNG, TWO512px COLUMNS by THREE512px ROWS, SIX figures left-to-right/top-to-bottom. Each ENTIRE character including BOTH wings, sword, cape, horns and toes must fit inside CENTRAL320x320 region of each512x512cell. Aim full silhouette height roughly300pixels at final1024x1536 resolution. Leave at least96px EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN on ALL FOUR SIDES of every cell. Broad gutters, all figures fully detached and uncropped, consistent pixel scale. Do not zoom characters up to fill the sheet. Complete anatomy and every wing/blade/cape tip must be visible.

Background and gaps between body parts fully transparent alpha0. Only1-2px edge antialiasing. Hard detailed solid crystal surfaces with light confined inside them. No floor, ground, shadows, halo, glow outside solids, bloom, haze, particles, motion blur, trails, labels, grids, borders, panels, text or extra objects. The checks are true NW REAR BACK VIEW in every frame, correct original anatomical RIGHT sword hand with LEFT cape, both established wings visible, complete uncropped gear, and subtle real six-phase breathing articulation.
